name: Eucalypt Australia Community Grants
summary: Small grants for community projects in Australia on eucalypts, including conservation, recovery and management work. The applicant must be an Australian legal entity with an ABN, or be auspiced by one.
reporting: A short acquittal of about 100 words with two high-definition photos, due on 28 February of the year after the grant.
